phrases.latin: Mox cochleam in saxō ūmidō rēpentem cōnspexit, deinde alteram, deinde plūrēs
phrases.english: Soon he spotted a snail crawling on a wet rock, then another, then more
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

cochlea.html: The quantity is uncertain, as in the screw entry.
